purpose: Non-transcribable owner-oracle layer. The active perturbation is read from the committed content of the three read-only upstream artifacts, never from an out-of-band flag. A memorized/copied-template answer that is correct only for the baseline (unperturbed) 3-way field mismatch must FAIL once the actual field values in the artifacts change, because the correct gate verdict and/or the correct field-literal grounding differ.

selector.detection: sha256 of each selector input file's current bytes must match exactly one perturbation entry's input_snapshots map; no match is a hard verifier error (unrecognized/drifted inputs state).

perturbations.description: Unperturbed reference packet: backend uses cursor_token, frontend uses nextCursor, QA uses page_token -- three-way mismatch, QA must be blocked.

The frontend and QA artifacts are revised so all three boundaries agree on cursor_token end-to-end (frontend consumes cursor_token directly instead of mapping nextCursor; QA fixtures retire page_token for cursor_token). Under this perturbation there is no mismatch: the gate must flip to PROCEED_TO_QA and QA may run.

The backend artifact is revised so the continuation field is renamed from cursor_token to next_page_cursor (frontend and QA are untouched, still nextCursor / page_token). The three-way mismatch and the REVISE_BEFORE_QA gate verdict are UNCHANGED, but the specific field literal a correct answer must cite is different from the baseline -- a candidate that transcribes the memorized 'cursor_token / nextCursor / page_token' triple without re-reading the current backend artifact must fail.
